title.narrative: Youth in the Lead: Arts and Culture for Inclusive Social Change

description.narrative:
The overall objective: to promote and protect: (i) human rights and fundamental freedoms, (ii) democracy, and (iii) the rule of law in Somalia.


The specific objective is to support CSOs to contribute to the promotion and protection of human rights, foster freedom of expression and enhance peacebuilding, conflict prevention and social cohesion, through arts, culture, and sports.

The total number of participants of the event will also be assessed.The four studies arepracticionerfriendly literature reviewrole of social media for youth radicalizationrole of womeninterlinkages of radicalisation dynamics at regional and local level

Value reported corresponds to the Direction Gnrale de la Sret Nationale of Morocco and the Maritime National Guard of Tunisia. These institutions were supported through equipment delivery and training.
